units.source_text: 前诗以莺比源氏，以群芳比诸夫人，以樱花比三公主；

en.t: The previous poem compared the warbler to Genji, the many flowers to the ladies, and the cherry blossoms to the Third Princess;

units.source_text: 此诗以青鸟比源氏，以深山古木比紫姬。

en.t: this poem compares the blue bird to Genji, and the ancient tree deep in the mountains to Lady Murasaki.
